newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE rise may be limited to about 4,650.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE rise may be limited to about 4,650.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may recover only slightly on Monday, perhaps no higher than 4,650, technical analysts said.

By closing above 4,610 after the mauling it received on Friday, the FTSE has avoided completing a bearish double-top chart pattern which consisted of a couple of peaks near 4,700 and neckline support around 4,610, they added.
And with interest focussing on the Halifax share floatation, financial stocks may be firm today.
By 0723 GMT, at the pre-market open the FTSE was indicated up 18.1 at 4,639.4.
The region near the FTSE's 10 day moving average -- which is now at 4,655 -- will be a stumbling block for the index over the next few days, analysts said.

But this lack of progress by the market should be sufficient to allow the FTSE's short-term momentum indicators to settle back a little more -- and this in turn will allow for a better chance for the market to recover in the weeks ahead.
In the meantime, the market will show its instability by rapid price swings as it tries to avoid being sucked below 4,600.
